title: Possible Slack token in source
description: A string with the shape of a Slack token (xoxb/xoxp/xoxa followed by a dash and token characters) was found in source. Anyone with repository access can use a live token with its scopes until it is revoked.
remediation: If this is a real token, revoke it in the Slack admin console, audit what it accessed, and replace it with a token stored outside version control. This detection does not prove the token is live.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the xox prefix format, which cannot prove a live credential. Short fragments and documentation mentions do not match.
